sell.reason: Tanaka remains the correct funding leg and the squad's weakest asset: lowest season average, falling market value, the largest seven-day value loss in the squad. Its original precondition was that a twelfth body must land first, and that may be satisfied within hours. A twelfth body is necessary but not sufficient. The slate is ranked by expected value, so win probability matters as much as market value: the cheap, low-average listings are where a bid at exactly market value actually wins, while the expensive high-average ones look richest and convert least. Nebel leads on that basis and expires in the morning rather than overnight. Weiser and Ouedraogo follow. All three are rising-flag Kickbase listings with no manager ask, all three resolve before the tick, and the bid on each is exactly market value with no raise under any circumstance — chasing one contested listing into the high cluster wipes out ten good flips. Amiri is the highest raw expected value on the board and is excluded anyway, partly on the unwind rule and partly because his listing expires in the middle of Georg's night.
